scene_summary: Greg's boat party reaches a strange drag in the Alder Basin channel where flattened reeds point upstream, two skiffs wait nearby, and Maro tests the water with a narrow brass disk.
visual_hook: A narrow reed channel, two waiting skiffs, flattened reeds pointing the wrong way, an irritated goat, and Maro suspending a brass disk over dark water while Greg watches from the boat.
paragraph_anchor: Maro took narrow brass disk from black case.
notes: Strong environment, object action, and directional mystery without requiring a major reveal.

scene_summary: Before dawn, Nessa arrives at camp in a gray scarf and waxed coat, one boot whitened with slurry, carrying a three-pronged brass fork and looking personally offended by the basin's construction.
visual_hook: Cold pre-dawn camp light, travel-worn Nessa with a long three-pronged brass instrument, pale slurry on one boot, and Greg meeting her beside the camp gear.
paragraph_anchor: She carried a three-pronged brass fork almost as long as my forearm and looked furious at architecture.
notes: Character entrance with a strong prop and distinctive silhouette.

scene_summary: Greg and the others cross the elevated basin ropewalk, a long timber-and-iron wall route with freight cages and open iron grating that forces Greg to place his crutches carefully.
visual_hook: High industrial catwalk over the basin, open iron grate under Greg's crutches, freight cages and counterweights nearby, with the route stretching far into the distance.
paragraph_anchor: Second turned to open iron grate.
notes: Excellent disability-aware movement scene and an opportunity for a strong high-angle or low-angle composition.

scene_summary: At night, tiny gray Glasswake mice with faint blue-white incisors investigate the camp food box while Greg notices them from beside the fire ring.
visual_hook: Small gray mice at the food box, their teeth glowing faint blue-white in the dark, low firelight, camp clutter, and Greg watching with a crutch within reach.
notes: Compact creature scene with strong lighting and immediate visual identity.

scene_summary: A tan, long-legged reed hound appears at the edge of moonlight beyond the drainage while Greg watches from camp, with more shapes implied in the reeds and Maro ready to drive them off with noise.
visual_hook: A narrow-chested, dog-like silhouette on too-long legs at the moonlit reed edge, dark drainage water between it and camp, Greg watching from the foreground.
location: Alder Basin camp drainage and reed edge
notes: Creature reveal with clean foreground-background staging and strong moonlight potential.

scene_summary: Greg's party reaches West Locks, a three-channel lock system cut through pale stone hills with house-tall gates, black iron teeth, stacked walkways, counterweight towers, cranes, and water held at visibly different levels.
visual_hook: A huge working lock complex with pale masonry, black iron gate teeth, multiple water levels, freight cranes, white signal strips, and Greg's party arriving small against the machinery.
paragraph_anchor: West Locks appeared properly ten minutes later.
notes: Large-scale infrastructure shot that expands the visual world instead of centering a conversation.

scene_summary: Inside the east gallery, a maintenance shade cloth covers part of the lock wall and floor while pale light moves faintly beneath it and workers keep the survey party to the inner edge without allowing contact.
visual_hook: Stone lock corridor, yellow chalk boundary, hanging maintenance cloth, and dim pale light glowing through the fabric like moonlight under a bedsheet while the party passes carefully.
paragraph_anchor: Under cloth, pale light moved faintly.
notes: Quiet supernatural/environmental image with strong contrast and a clear no-contact boundary.

scene_summary: A loose brass custody tag slides toward the freight cradle grate and Greg deliberately gives it a tiny external push, changing its angle just enough for it to strike the raised case corner instead of falling through.
visual_hook: Close action shot of a small brass tag skidding toward an iron grate, black case corner in frame, Greg braced on crutches nearby, and the tag visibly changing path at the last instant.
notes: Small but important action beat. Keep the effect subtle rather than turning it into flashy magic.

scene_summary: At the north station mast, a white thread tied to arm two blows with the south wind while the heavy black arm itself slowly creeps west in the wrong direction as Dask measures and Maro checks with his brass disk.
visual_hook: Three-armed black signal mast on a stone plinth, one white thread streaming with the wind while its arm creeps against it, Dask measuring and Maro holding a brass disk below.
notes: Good movement-vs-movement composition where the thread and mast arm visibly disagree.

scene_summary: Behind the station, Greg sits beside his crutches facing a brass washer on a smooth board while Dask marks measurements and the others watch a controlled test; on the third attempt the washer moves cleanly to the right.
visual_hook: Low, intimate experiment scene with Greg seated, crutches laid beside him, a tiny brass washer on a marked board in the foreground, Dask crouched with measurements, and the group watching without spectacle.
notes: A restrained progress image. Emphasize measurement, posture, and witness attention rather than visual effects.
